content_html:
Dependent Origination → No First Cause → Emptiness

Because things arise dependently, there is no ultimate first cause. Because there is no first cause and nothing stands alone, phenomena lack inherent essence — they are empty.

No first cause and emptiness are inseparable: dependent origination denies an ultimate source, and emptiness names the lack of intrinsic essence that follows from this relationality.

Domain Parallel Insight Example
Neuroscience Mind/memory arise from distributed interactions, not a core origin. No “first neuron” for a memory; recall depends on context and reconstruction.
Physics Macro-properties emerge from relations; initial conditions are not metaphysical causes. Temperature, turbulence, symmetry-breaking; Big Bang as a state, not a first cause.
